finding.claim: An exact candidate-to-Validation integration remains valid through a later Reviewer-only revision only while invalidation, behavior provenance, report/checker/artifact bindings, and Validation evidence/gate lineage remain exact.

data_provenance.source: Temporary deep copy of the exact revision-24 repository candidate.
data_provenance.consent: Not applicable; no personal or external data
data_provenance.transformations: Deterministic temporary state/report construction and one-field adverse mutations only
data_provenance.leakage_controls: Canonical state and product remained read-only; temporary directories were destroyed after execution

execution.command: python3 -B -c '<embedded temporary exact closure fixture and sequential eight-case lineage matrix>'
procedure: Copy the exact repository to a temporary directory, excluding caches and this report.
Bind a temporary exact passing closure report to candidate revision 24 and current checker/schema digests.
Create exact Validation integration at revision 25 with matching report artifact, passing Validation evidence, and passing Validation gate.
Advance only lifecycle bookkeeping to Reviewer-only/current revision 26 without changing invalidation or behavior provenance.
Run python3 -B tools/meva_check.py check-release --root <temporary-case-root> for the positive fixture and each one-field adverse mutation.
Stop immediately if the positive fails or any adverse passes.
execution.metric: Exact exit code, release_integrity token, nonempty/empty errors, binding mode, and candidate revision
execution.direction: positive must pass; every adverse must reject
execution.threshold: 1/1 positive pass with errors=[] and 7/7 adverse cases fail with nonempty errors
